title: First projection of tower comparison
statement: For the explicit cycle-pullback tower, the comparison isomorphism exists and satisfies the first pullback projection equation.

proof.text: Construct canonicalComparison using the proved recursive stage identity, evaluation of the kernel and pullback, and T.mapIso. The evaluated first projection is the original functor-category first projection. Naturality of π moves it across T.map of the comparison. The transported step augmentation is precisely π followed by that first projection. Return the canonical isomorphism and this proved equation. No use of the combined comparison theorem is made.

proof_origin.place: Y5 retirement: the adopted upstream module contains the identical canonical construction and projection proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem tower_comparison_canonical_first (T : A ⥤ A) (π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A)
    (F : B ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ) (N : ℤ) (b : B) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ N) :
    (canonicalComparison T π F N b i hi).hom ≫ π.app _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      (augmentation T π F N i).app b
